name: figure

facts.source: analytic definitions in the continuity subsection; no external or random data
functions: Cantor function on [0,1]; depth-8 polygon for display
facts.sampling: 601 evenly spaced points for smooth functions; all 512 vertices of the depth-8 Cantor polygon
facts.cantor_uniform_error_bound: ||C-C_8||_infty <= 2^-8; properties in annotation belong to limiting C, not C_8
facts.finite_approximation_warning: Every finite polygon is Lipschitz and absolutely continuous; the displayed finite graph is not a proof that C is not absolutely continuous.

square_markers.role: one pair from x_n=n, y_n=n+1/n; proof requires the entire sequence, not this plotted pair

facts.interpretation: curve height and apparent smoothness do not establish continuity type; definitions and analytic arguments in text do
